title: Personal brand strategy
caption: I've decided to keep damaging my online reputation until it underflows and wraps around to INT_MAX.

image.alt: VS Code-style editor showing JavaScript that sets a signed 32-bit reputation score to -2147483648. A comment says ‘one more post’ before subtracting one. The terminal prints 2147483647: the score has wrapped from the minimum to the maximum.

processNote: The joke started with my wording. AI helped edit it and made the code example and HTML/CSS editor recreation. The code was run to check the result. The image is a browser screenshot of that recreation, not AI-generated artwork.
